name: orca-dev-ops
description: Orca-managed worktree workflow and coordination rules for Codex, provided as a skill only (no hooks; use the Codex sandbox flags and the repository's AGENTS.md for guardrails).

interface.longDescription: Guides Codex through Orca worktree planning, task control, review, and delivery. Ships as a skill only; unlike the Claude Code plugin, it has no hooks or slash command, so the sandbox flags and the repository's AGENTS.md rules are the only guardrails.
